ValidationRule.description: Session Start date and end date should be within or equal to Event start date and Event End Date
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( OR( Session_Start_Date__c < Event__r.Event_Start_Date__c, Session_Start_Date__c > Event__r.Event_End_Date__c, Session_End_Date__c > Event__r.Event_End_Date__c, Session_End_Date__c < Event__r.Event_Start_Date__c ), true, OR( AND( Session_Start_Date__c == Event__r.Event_Start_Date__c, Start_Time__c < Event__r.Start_Time__c ), AND( Session_End_Date__c == Event__r.Event_End_Date__c, End_Time__c > Event__r.End_Time__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Session Start / End Date & Time should not be outside the Event Start / End Date & Time range
